what: L1 W2 town (C4/R8): the town kit's trim sheets and look, painted by tools/look/town.py (its docstring). Colors: each region's class paint.albedo.mid (materials.json, hand-set from MB3 over the day rig's measured response, the arithmetic in the class's w2 line) times the region's hand gains here.
from: (b) MB3 SETTS, PLASTER & BEAMS, STONE, ROOF, WOOD (day); LOOK_BIBLE rules 9 (one color per block +-0.06, lit bevel, cool joints, nothing under 3 cm) and 10 (chunky: big-medium-small, bigger bevels, rounder stones); (a) the play and town cameras (07, 13); (c) the regions and their metres are env_house_atlas.py's and env_roof_atlas.py's (house_atlas.json, roof_atlas.json), kept so env_house.py's and env_roof.py's UVs fit.

house.from: the walls' trim sheet (E9b1's regions), repainted from nothing (the rubble's CC0 photo source retired)

rubble.from: MB3 STONE: rounded coursed blocks, lavender-grey with warmer and lighter ones, deep cool joints

plaster.from: MB3 PLASTER & BEAMS: flat warm plaster, two or three big soft masses

timber.from: MB3 PLASTER & BEAMS' beams: dark oak, a few long strokes; gains = MB3_beam_day all_lin [0.1344, 0.0469, 0.0278] / day lit [3.3618, 2.3067, 1.0555] = [0.04, 0.0203, 0.0263], over plank's mid #7e5046 (lin [0.206, 0.080, 0.058])

ashlar.from: MB3 STONE's dressed arch stones, a step lighter than the rubble (joints are geometry)

iron.from: MB3 STONE's door ring and straps (wrought)

planks.from: MB3 STONE's door boards: dark brown boards, their seams

roof.from: the roof trim sheet (E9b2's regions), repainted from nothing

pantile.from: MB3 ROOF: chunky tile rows, each tile one color, its lit lip, the lap's cool band (env_roof.py's course 0.3125 m, 12 across)

shingle.from: 07 target's roofs (warm brown-red); MB3 ROOF's rows (env_roof.py's 0.25 m course)

soffit.from: the eaves' boarding, a step lighter than the beams

brick.from: chimney brick in the roof's clay (MB3 ROOF's hue)

endgrain.from: a rafter's end, the beams' oak a step lighter

lead.from: lead: a cool dark grey off the stone

house_look._from: L1 W2 town (C4): tints near white (the trim sheet carries each class's hand-set color; houses vary +-4% only), the photo-era weathering off (grime, splash, stains, the ground storey's rise, broad noise, mottle, lost plaster; roof soot, moss, ridge soot, eave moss, the clay's desaturation): rule 9 (one color varied inside its range), MB3 (clean painted surfaces)
